_description: HTTP 401 - no Authorization header on a protected route (IAM middleware). Other details with the same envelope: 'The access token is invalid or has expired.', 'The account of this access token no longer exists.', 'The access token has expired.' (JWT challenge, with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer), 'Invalid username or password' (POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in), 'Unauthorized: invalid or missing API key.' (Edge routes), invalid/expired/reused refresh token (POST /api/v1/auth/refresh).
title: Unauthorized
detail: A valid access token is required.
